newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products stable to firmer.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products stable to firmer.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to slightly firmer on Thursday, traders said.
Low sulphur diesel barges were offered at July IPE +$5.50 basis Rotterdam and +$5.25 basis Flushing. July IPE was trading unchanged at $167.50 a tonne at 1019 GMT.
A barge of refinery grade heating oil changed hands at July IPE +$0.50, while outright gas oil screen values were steady.
Gasoline was quiet and broadly steady. Eurograde barges were again talked around $187 fob ARA. Cargoes were around $4 lower.
High sulphur fuel barges were offered at around $86 fob ARA, around $1 higher than Wednesday's traded levels.
